name: Languid Isqulug OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-15: Cavern of Sundered Songs

generalAbilities.name: Host Scent 30 feet
generalAbilities.description: An isqulug can precisely sense any creature infected with isqulugia within 30 feet, and knows the current stage of the disease.

generalAbilities.name: All-Around Vision
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster can see in all directions simultaneously and therefore can't be flanked.

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Cold)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

offensiveAbilities.name: Expel Infestation
offensiveAbilities.description:
The isqulug expels larvae from the hivemind in its head in a 30ft Cone. Creatures in this area take 5d10 Piercing Damage damage as the swarm feeds on their flesh (Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save). Any creature that takes damage is exposed to isqulugia.

The isqulug becomes Stupefied 1 for 1d4 rounds, during which it can't Expel Infestation.

offensiveAbilities.name: Isqulugia
offensiveAbilities.description:
Isqulugia's Sickened, Slowed, and Paralyzed conditions can't be removed until this affliction is removed

Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 Sickened 1 (1 hour)

Stage 2 Fatigued and Sickened 2 (1 day)

Stage 3 fatigued and Slowed 1 (1 day)

Stage 4 Paralyzed (1 day)

Stage 5 the creature dies, and its body violently transforms into a new isqulug. Wish, similar magic, or a 9th-rank Resurrect ritual can return the victim to life. The new isqulug remains even if the victim is brought back to life.

offensiveAbilities.name: Malleability
offensiveAbilities.description: The isqulug can Squeeze through tight spaces as if it were a Small creature. While Squeezing, it can move at its full Speed. The isqulug can even Squeeze through spaces that typically fit only a Tiny creature, but does so at the standard speed for Squeezing.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swamp Stride
offensiveAbilities.description: An isqulug ignores difficult terrain that's caused by typical features of swamps.

cantrips.name: Dancing Lights
cantrips.description: You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

lv1spells.name: Pass Without Trace (Constant)
lv1spells.description:
You obscure the tracks you leave behind and make it harder for others to find you. The DC of checks to Track you gains a +4 status bonus or is equal to your spell DC, whichever results in a higher DC. You can benefit from only one pass without trace spell at a time.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (4th) The duration increases to 8 hours. The spell has a range of 20 feet and an area of a 20-foot-emanation, affecting up to 10 creatures of your choice within that area.

lv4spells.name: Fly
lv4spells.description:
The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

lv5spells.name: Control Water
lv5spells.description: By imposing your will upon the water, you can raise or lower the level of water in the chosen area by 10 feet. Water creatures in the area are subjected to the effects of Slow.

lv5spells.name: Entangle (At will)
lv5spells.description: Plants in the area entangle creatures. The area counts as difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it is also Immobilized for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to Escape at entangle's DC to remove these effects.

lv5spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
lv5spells.duration: until the next time you make your daily preparations
lv5spells.description:
You create an illusion that causes natural terrain to look, sound, feel, and smell like a different kind of terrain. This doesn't disguise any structures or creatures in the area. Any creature that touches the illusion or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (5th) Your image can also disguise structures or create illusory structures (but still doesn't disguise creatures).

lv5spells.name: Obscuring Mist (At will)
lv5spells.description: You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become Concealed, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

lv6spells.name: Tangling Creepers
lv6spells.description: Dense, twitching creepers sprout from every surface and fill any bodies of water in the area. Any creature moving on the land, or Climbing or Swimming within the creepers, takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds while in the area. Once per round, you can make a vine lash out from any square within the expanse of creepers by using a single action, which has the concentrate trait. This vine has a 15-foot reach and makes a makes a melee spell attack roll against the target. If the attack succeeds, the vine pulls the target into the creepers and makes it Immobilized for 1 round or until the creature Escapes (against your spell DC), whichever comes first.
